subject.title: fix(providers): publish Meta under canonical package name

question: Should the Meta provider rename and `@openclaw/meta-provider` publication metadata land without a doctor migration for the old current-main-only `meta-model-api` id?
rationale: The code path is coherent, but the change intentionally alters provider/auth/config identity and package publication surfaces, so maintainers need to own the compatibility and release decision.

options.title: Accept current-main-only rename
options.body: Land after exact-head checks and release/package proof pass, treating `meta-model-api` as unshipped and not migration-worthy.

options.title: Add migration before merge
options.body: If maintainers believe any shipped or supported pre-release users may have `meta-model-api` config, require a doctor-owned migration or documented recovery before landing.

options.title: Defer official publication
options.body: If npm/ClawHub ownership is not ready, keep the provider bundled-only and postpone the publish metadata.

recommendation.title: Accept current-main-only rename
recommendation.body: Land after exact-head checks and release/package proof pass, treating `meta-model-api` as unshipped and not migration-worthy.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent owns this PR and the package/release follow-up surface, making him the best available owner for the merge-risk choice.
